name: Cyclopropylmescaline
summary: Cyclopropylmescaline, AKA CPM, is a psychedelic/hallucinogenic that was produced by Alexander Shulgin. It causes visual and auditory hallucinations and is reported to have a long duration. There is limited information on this drug, caution is advised
